nodes.description: Administrator address of the cToken; guards all privileged admin functions.
Pending administrator awaiting acceptance via _acceptAdmin.
Comptroller contract that governs policy hooks for this cToken.
Interest rate model contract whose external getBorrowRate/getSupplyRate are invoked.
Total outstanding borrows of the underlying, mutated by accrueInterest/borrowFresh/repayBorrowFresh.
Total reserves held by the market, mutated by accrueInterest and _reduceReservesFresh.
Accumulator of earned interest used to compute borrower balances.
Block number of last interest accrual; used for freshness checks.
Mapping of borrower address to BorrowSnapshot (principal and interestIndex).
Total number of cTokens in circulation used for exchange rate math.
ERC20 allowance mapping written by approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
Official record of cToken balances per account.
Fraction of accrued interest set aside for reserves.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the nonReentrant modifier.
Comptroller mapping of cToken address to Market metadata including collateralFactorMantissa.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, transfer sources, liquidator and borrower identities.
Block time referenced by the Comp delegateBySig expiry check.
Initializes market parameters; guarded by admin check and one-time initialization requirement.
ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to transferTokens with msg.sender as spender/src.
ERC20 transferFrom entry point using msg.sender, src and dst.
Writes transferAllowances[msg.sender][spender] = amount.
Applies accrued interest to totalBorrows, totalReserves and borrowIndex; core arithmetic site.
Executes a borrow: updates accountBorrows and totalBorrows then calls doTransferOut before borrowVerify.
Executes a repayment: calls doTransferIn first, then decreases accountBorrows and totalBorrows.
Liquidation flow: repays borrow then performs external seize on the collateral cToken.
External entry point for collateral seizure, dispatching to seizeInternal with msg.sender as seizer.
Admin-only function to set pendingAdmin.
Admin handover acceptance; requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin.
Admin-only function that validates and sets the comptroller.
Admin-only reserve factor update with freshness and bounds checks.
Admin-only reserve reduction that transfers underlying out to admin via doTransferOut.
Admin-only interest rate model replacement with freshness check.
Adds msg.sender to the given markets for liquidity calculation.
Removes msg.sender from a market after liquidity and borrow-balance checks.
Comptroller policy hook validating a borrow; reads oracle price and market collateral factor.
Comptroller policy hook validating a mint against supply caps and pause flags.
Comptroller policy hook validating liquidation; reads oracle prices and close factor.
Admin-only function listing a new cToken market.
Signature-based delegation using ecrecover, nonce and expiry timestamp.
Internal Comp token transfer performing balance updates and delegate vote movement.
External transfer of underlying/ETH out of the contract; state must be updated before this call.
External transfer of underlying/ETH into the contract invoking an untrusted token.
External call to another cToken's seize() during liquidation, re-entering token logic.
Add/sub/mul arithmetic on mantissas (add_, sub_, mul_) that must be guarded against overflow/underflow.
Comparison of msg.sender against admin controlling privileged entry points.
ecrecover-based signature recovery used to authorize delegation.
External price oracle call whose return value drives collateral and liquidation math.
External interest rate model call returning the per-block borrow rate.
Amount of underlying supplied by a minter.
Amount of underlying requested by a borrower.
Amount of underlying being repaid; uint256(-1) means repay full balance.
Number of cTokens to redeem into underlying.
New pending administrator address supplied to _setPendingAdmin.
New comptroller contract supplied to _setComptroller.
Account address whose borrow/cToken balances are queried.
Address approved to spend tokens in approve.
Destination address of a token transfer.
BorrowLocalVars memory struct holding intermediate borrow balances.
LiquidateBorrowLocalVars memory struct holding repay/seize intermediate values.
Per-block interest factor computed in accrueInterest via multiplication.
Current block number fetched in accrueInterest.
Number of blocks elapsed since last accrual, computed by subtraction.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the admin state variable to authorize privileged calls.
The admin state variable is the reference identity in the authorization comparison.
_setPendingAdmin is gated by the msg.sender == admin check.
_acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin.
_setComptroller reverts for non-admin callers.
_setReserveFactorFresh checks msg.sender against admin.
_reduceReservesFresh checks msg.sender against admin before transferring out.
_setInterestRateModelFresh checks msg.sender against admin.
_supportMarket requires msg.sender == admin.
transfer passes msg.sender as spender and source.
transferFrom passes msg.sender as spender for the allowance check.
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
borrower identity originates from msg.sender passed by borrowInternal.
payer identity originates from msg.sender passed by repayBorrowInternal.
liquidator is msg.sender forwarded by liquidateBorrowInternal.
seize uses msg.sender as the seizer token rather than a parameter.
enterMarkets registers msg.sender into each market.
exitMarket operates on msg.sender membership and balances.
borrowAllowed may require msg.sender == cToken when adding the borrower to the market.
mintAllowed evaluates pause flags and credit-account status for the minter.
Signature expiry is compared against the block timestamp, making authorization time dependent.
delegateBySig recovers the signatory with ecrecover before authorizing the delegation.
approve writes the transferAllowances mapping.
transfer moves value between accountTokens entries.
initialize invokes _setComptroller internally.
initialize invokes _setInterestRateModelFresh internally.
accrueInterest reads and rewrites accrualBlockNumber.
accrueInterest reads and rewrites totalBorrows.
accrueInterest reads and rewrites totalReserves.
accrueInterest reads and rewrites borrowIndex.
reserveFactorMantissa scales interest allocated to reserves.
interestRateModel address is the target of the external rate call.
accrueInterest makes an external callback to interestRateModel.getBorrowRate.
simpleInterestFactor is produced by fixed-point multiplication requiring overflow guards.
currentBlockNumber is used to detect whether accrual is required.
blockDelta is derived by subtraction and feeds the interest multiplication.
borrowFresh increases totalBorrows by borrowAmount.
borrowFresh reads and writes the borrower's accountBorrows snapshot.
borrowFresh requires accrualBlockNumber == getBlockNumber().
The nonReentrant modifier toggles _notEntered to block re-entrant borrows.
borrowAmount determines the borrowed value and the transfer-out amount.
BorrowLocalVars carries the intermediate new borrow balances.
borrowFresh performs an external transfer out to the borrower after storage updates.
account (borrower) is passed into borrowBalanceStoredInternal.
repayBorrowFresh decreases totalBorrows by the repaid amount.
repayBorrowFresh stores the current borrowIndex into the borrower snapshot.
repayBorrowFresh reads previous principal and interestIndex and writes new principal.
repayAmount (or uint256(-1) sentinel) selects the repayment amount.
repayBorrowFresh performs an external token transfer in before finalizing balances.
The nonReentrant modifier protects repayBorrow entry points via _notEntered.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls repayBorrowFresh to settle the debt.
The nested repay inside liquidation invokes the untrusted doTransferIn token transfer.
liquidateBorrowFresh makes an external seize call on the collateral cToken.
LiquidateBorrowLocalVars holds repay error, actual repay amount and seize tokens.
comptroller is queried for liquidateBorrowAllowed and liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens.
liquidateBorrowAllowed reads untrusted oracle prices for borrow and collateral markets.
borrowAllowed reads the oracle price before validating liquidity.
_reduceReservesFresh decreases totalReserves by reduceAmount.
_reduceReservesFresh transfers the reduced reserves out to the admin.
The nonReentrant modifier guards _reduceReserves entry via _notEntered.
The external seize call executes the collateral cToken's seize() entry point.
redeemTokens determines the amount of underlying transferred out on redeem.
newPendingAdmin is stored into pendingAdmin.
newComptroller is validated and stored into the comptroller state variable.
spender keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
dst is the recipient of the transferred tokens.
mintAmount is transferred in from the minter through doTransferIn.
_acceptAdmin authorizes against the pendingAdmin state variable.
borrowAllowed and the liquidity math read collateralFactorMantissa from markets.
